args.message:
Fix money rounding to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (FIN-212)

round_money claimed to use banker's rounding but actually used
ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so halves round to the
nearest even cent, matching tests/test_money.py.

args.head: fix/money-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, FIN-212)
args.body:
## Summary
`src/money.py` documented banker's rounding (per FIN-212) but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, causing `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` to fail in the nightly build.

## Change
- Import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money` so exact halves round to the nearest even cent (e.g. `2.675` → `2.68`, `2.665` → `2.66`).

## Testing
CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed.

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Diagnosis:** `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring (and FIN-212) specifying banker's rounding, which is why `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` failed (e.g. `2.665 → 2.67` instead of `2.66`).
- **Fix:** Created branch `fix/money-bankers-rounding` and changed `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` (commit `08d3cd5986`).
- **CI:** Triggered run `ci-0001` on the branch — it passed.
- **PR:** Opened PR #101 against `main` ("Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, FIN-212)") with **alex** requested as reviewer: https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101

I did not merge, since merging into main requires a code owner's approval.
